- **W2 item 8 (`S103-NNU-BUNDLE-EXHAUSTIVENESS`) and W1 item 6 (`S103-VIIBS-CLAUSE-B-SCOPE-ANNOTATION`)** touch §VII.BS from different layers — item 6 ANNOTATES the clause-(b) scope (necessity vs sufficiency); item 8 TESTS the Open Q6 bundle-exhaustiveness premise the annotation names.
